result.title: V-LUMEN: Visual Lookup Memory for Embedding Scaling in Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Embedding-level scaling expands the capacity of language models through lookup-based memory rather than by increasing model depth, width, or dense computation. Extending this idea to vision-language models (VLMs) is challenging because visual features are continuous, spatially structured, and query-dependent, unlike discrete text tokens that naturally support n-gram lookup. We introduce V-LUMEN, a visual lookup memory for VLMs. V-LUMEN discretizes visual features with a frozen codebook, builds spatially aware memory keys through spatial aggregation-based hashing, and modulates them with text-conditioned relevance signals; all addressing is non-parametric, and the retrieved embeddings are fused into the backbone through a gated residual pathway. On five reasoning-intensive benchmarks, V-LUMEN substantially improves a frozen Qwen3-VL-2B backbone and transfers zero-shot to three benchmarks whose images are disjoint from the training data. At a matched parameter budget, moving part of a LoRA or MoE adapter's capacity into V-LUMEN preserves accuracy on two backbones, indicating that external visual memory is an independent capacity axis rather than a stronger adaptation method. Because lookup cost is constant in table size and incurred only once at prefill, this capacity grows in storage rather than in per-token compute. Code is available at https://github.com/miso-choi/V-Lumen.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 V-LUMEN：用冻结码本离散化视觉特征、以空间聚合哈希构造记忆键，并用文本条件相关性信号调制检索，将召回嵌入经门控残差注入 VLM 主干，在冻结的 Qwen3-VL-2B 上以存储而非逐 token 计算扩展容量。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 VLM 推理中视觉证据检索及其注入 latent 状态的问题直接相关，其「外部视觉记忆是独立容量轴」的结论可供核查；但检索到的内容是否被答案实际使用、以及是否等同推理期状态生成仍需读原文确认。
